text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text: This entire turn of events should finally end today.
text_block_list.orig_text: この騒動も今日で終わりですね……

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
I want it to end right now, if I'm being honest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
こんな怖いことは
早く終わってほしいよぅ……

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
You're such a scaredy-cat, Kurumi. ♪
Oh well. When you get to my age,
stuff like this stops being scary. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
クルミは怖がりだねぇ♪
まあ、
私はクルミよりお姉ちゃんだから、
ぜんぜん怖くないけどねぇ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、アヤネちゃん！
アヤネちゃんの後ろから黒い影が……！？

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Wha—?!
Appearing out of nowhere is just cheating!
Huh? There's nothing there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぇっ！？
きゅ、急にくるのは反則ぅっ……！！
……あれ
……なにもいない？

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Looks like you're as much of a scaredy-cat as me, Ayane. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ……
やっぱりアヤネちゃんも、
私といっしょで怖いんだねぇ……♪

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
N-no I'm not!
You just, uh, took me by surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、ちがうもん！
いまのはその……
ちょっと驚いただけなんだからぁ！

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee. ♪
Enough teasing, you two.
Let's bring this to an end once and for all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ……♪
さあ二人とも、
最後まで気を抜かずにいきましょう！
